description.text: Training Objective This course is designed to teach Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, and mathematics, etc, after one academic year (Fall and Spring Semesters, totally 36 weeks) continuous study in “Preparatory Course”, students can finally achieve the entry level of bachelor’s programs (offered in Chinese) at UIBE. In other words, and reach HSK 5-6 in Chinese; pass level of College Entrance Exam in mathematics (for arts students), and College English Test band 3 in English. Courses Offered · Chinese: 24 class hours per week · Mathematics: 3 class hours per week · English: 3 class hours per week Term Set · March -July for Spring Semester: · September - January for Fall Semester: (Note: For exact registration time, please refer to Admission Notice) Application Period · April – August 31st for Fall Semester: · October – November 30 for Spring Semester: Tuition · CNY11,600/semester CNY 22,300/academic year · Advance payment of CNY2,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester

duration.text: The Preparatory Course for Bachelor Programs at University of International Business and Economics is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3097 USD/per year ￥ 22300 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of highest education 5.Certificate of employment or education Students still at school should provide school attendance certificate, graduates who have a job should provide working certificate. Certificate should be written in English and Chinese.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.Over age of 18. Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial certificate of guardianship Note: For those who apply for Fall Semester, a copy of HSK Level 3 is required; or they should pass the Chinese Entrance Exam (equal to HSK Level 3) organized by UIBE; For those who apply for Spring Semester, a copy of HSK Level 4 is required; or they should pass the Chinese Entrance Exam (equal to HSK Level 4) organized by UIBE;
